name: onesmallui-monorepo
description: OneSmallUI (1SmUI): a futuristic, WCAG AAA React + SCSS component library.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @onesmall/ui && npm run build -w @onesmallui/docs
scripts.dev: npm run build:lib && npm run dev -w @onesmallui/docs
scripts.check: npm run check:contrast && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
